name: ZSF_DS_METRIC_DIM_META
description: This table will store the metadata corresponding to the object and attributes required to construct a custom dimension.

columns.name: METRIC_DIM_META_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for metric dimension metadata.

columns.name: METRIC_DIM_CODE
columns.description: Uniquely identifies a metric dimension. This can be one of Resource Hierarchy, Territory Hierarchy, Product Hierarchy, Business Unit etc.

columns.name: DIM_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: The type of dimension source - whether it is based on a lookup or a standard object or a custom object.

columns.name: DIM_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Based on the DIM_SOURCE_TYPE a corresponding value that helps identify the data source for the dimension.

columns.name: DIM_SOURCE_FILTER_CRITERIA
columns.description: Criteria that would be applied on the dimension source to restrict the data that gets fetched to create the dimension.

columns.name: DIM_SOURCE_KEY_ATTR
columns.description: Name of the attribute that is the unique identifier of the dimension source.

columns.name: DIM_SOURCE_PARENT_KEY_ATTR
columns.description: Name of the attribute that is the parent of a given dimension source instance.

columns.name: DIM_SOURCE_NAME_ATTR
columns.description: Name of the attribute that contains the name of a given dimension source instance.

columns.name: DIM_SOURCE_OWNER_KEY_ATTR
columns.description: Name of the attribute that contains the unique identifier of the owner of a given dimension source instance, provided this dimension represents a Participant.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
